detail.name: SpendME
detail.description: The everyday account that does good, every day.

features.additionalInfo: No withdrawal fees at thousands of Australian ATMs.
Make payments and transactions in real-time. Send and receive money in an instant with PayID enabled accounts.

Charged when a balance enquiry is performed at an ATM outside of Australia. A fee may also be charged by the ATM owner which should be displayed on the screen before proceeding with the enquiry or associated withdrawal.
No overdrawn fees if you happen to overdraw your account.
Make transactions all from the palm of your hand. Make your money mobile and pay on the go with Apple Pay, Samsung Pay or Google Pay.

Manage your money easily. Set spending budgets on specific categories like groceries, bills and more. And get personalised insights and real-time alerts all in the palm of your hands with our handy banking app.
Never miss a payment on your everyday bills or recurring transactions. We'll give you a heads up when your bills are due, so you can make sure you've got the funds available.
No transaction fees within Australia.
Charged when a withdrawal is performed at an ATM outside of Australia. A fee may also be charged by the ATM owner and should be displayed on the screen before proceeding with the withdrawal.
Grow your savings whenever you spend. Round up debit card transactions to the nearest dollar and we'll put the extra change straight into one of your savings accounts.

Fee charged by ME for any International Transaction which includes; any transaction made in a foreign currency; or when any transaction is processed outside of Australia (in Australian dollars or a foreign currency). It is calculated as a percentage of the Australian dollar equivalent.
We've made monthly account keeping fees on your SpendME Account a thing of the past.

detail.name: HomeME
detail.description: Whether you're saving for your first home, forever home or a home for someone else, ME's HomeME account has the features to help you get home.

features.additionalInfo: Your account automatically comes with a SpendME transaction account. It's the perfect match to help you manage your money.
A HomeME savings account with ME comes with the ME Go app - the banking app designed to make your everyday banking easier.
All deposits up to $250,000 are protected by the Federal Government's deposit guarantee, so your savings are secure with us.

Enjoy bonus interest each month when you meet the criteria. Simply deposit a minimum of $2,000 into your linked SpendME Account from an external bank account (cash and cheques excluded).
